## Isoform-level analysis

### Settings: group's objects (from 01_load_data.qmd)

```{r}
library(DEXSeq)
library(DESeq2)
library(tidyverse)
options(bitmapType = "cairo")   # plots on server without a screen

alpha     <- 0.05
dIFcutoff <- 0.1    # isoform switch = FDR < 0.05 and |dIF| > 0.1 (Vitting-Seerup et al. 2017)
outDir    <- here::here("results", "person3")
dir.create(outDir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

inVitro <- list(name = "GSE135188",
                counts = isoform_count1,        # isoform counts
                meta = metadata_in_vitro_1,     # metadata
                conditionCol = "treatment",     # column with CS / air
                covariate = "donor",            # same donor in both conditions
                paired = TRUE)

inVivo  <- list(name = "GSE130967",
                counts = isoform_count2,
                meta = metadata_in_vivo_1,      # use the same samples as Person 2
                conditionCol = "smoking",       # smoker / nonsmoker
                covariate = NULL,               # e.g. "sex" if that column exists
                paired = FALSE)

if (!exists("isoInfo")) {
  isoInfo <- read_rds(paste0('/home/projects/22140/exam_data/',
                             'Homo_sapiens.GRCh38.107.chr_patch_hapl_scaff_tx_info.Rds'))
}
isoInfo <- as.data.frame(isoInfo)
if (!"isoform_id" %in% colnames(isoInfo)) isoInfo$isoform_id <- isoInfo$transcript_id
if (!"gene_name"  %in% colnames(isoInfo)) isoInfo$gene_name  <- isoInfo$gene_id
```

### Helper: line up counts and metadata

```{r prep}
prepData <- function(d) {
  counts <- as.data.frame(d$counts)
  idCol <- intersect(c("isoform_id", "transcript_id"), colnames(counts))
  if (length(idCol)) { rownames(counts) <- counts[[idCol[1]]]; counts[[idCol[1]]] <- NULL }

  meta <- as.data.frame(d$meta)
  # find the metadata column that holds the sample names of the count matrix
  hits <- sapply(meta, function(x) sum(as.character(x) %in% colnames(counts)))
  if (length(hits) && max(hits) > 0) {
    meta$sample_id <- as.character(meta[[names(which.max(hits))]])
  } else if (any(rownames(meta) %in% colnames(counts))) {
    meta$sample_id <- rownames(meta)
  } else stop(d$name, ": no metadata column matches the sample names of the counts")
  meta <- meta[meta$sample_id %in% colnames(counts), ]

  for (col in c(d$conditionCol, d$covariate)) if (!col %in% colnames(meta))
    stop(d$name, ": column '", col, "' not in metadata. Columns are: ",
         paste(colnames(meta), collapse = ", "))

  # condition: control (air / non-smoker) as reference level
  lv <- unique(as.character(meta[[d$conditionCol]]))
  if (length(lv) != 2) stop(d$name, ": '", d$conditionCol, "' has ", length(lv),
                            " groups (", paste(lv, collapse = ", "), "), need exactly 2")
  ref <- lv[grepl("air|non|control|ctrl|never", lv, ignore.case = TRUE)][1]
  if (is.na(ref)) ref <- lv[1]
  meta$condition <- factor(meta[[d$conditionCol]], levels = c(ref, setdiff(lv, ref)))
  meta$cov <- if (is.null(d$covariate)) NA else factor(meta[[d$covariate]])
  cat(d$name, ": reference =", levels(meta$condition)[1],
      ", case =", levels(meta$condition)[2], "\n")
  if (is.null(d$covariate)) print(table(meta$condition)) else print(table(meta$condition, meta$cov))

  counts <- round(as.matrix(counts[, meta$sample_id]))
  list(counts = counts, meta = meta)
}
```

### Main analysis (one function, run on both datasets)

```{r function}
runIsoformAnalysis <- function(d) {
  name <- d$name
  x <- prepData(d); isoCounts <- x$counts; meta <- x$meta
  ref <- levels(meta$condition)[1]; case <- levels(meta$condition)[2]
  hasCov <- !is.null(d$covariate)

  ## ---- Filtering: >= 10 reads in >= 3 samples, genes with >= 2 isoforms ----
  txInfo <- isoInfo[match(rownames(isoCounts), isoInfo$isoform_id), ]
  geneCounts <- rowsum(isoCounts[!is.na(txInfo$gene_id), ],
                       txInfo$gene_id[!is.na(txInfo$gene_id)])   # for DESeq2 below
  keep <- !is.na(txInfo$gene_id) & rowSums(isoCounts >= 10) >= 3
  isoCounts <- isoCounts[keep, ]; txInfo <- txInfo[keep, ]
  multiIso <- txInfo$gene_id %in% names(which(table(txInfo$gene_id) >= 2))
  isoCounts <- isoCounts[multiIso, ]; txInfo <- txInfo[multiIso, ]
  cat(name, ":", nrow(isoCounts), "isoforms in", length(unique(txInfo$gene_id)), "genes tested\n")

  ## ---- QC: isoform-level PCA (condition vs donor) ---------------------------
  vsd <- vst(DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(isoCounts, meta, design = ~ 1), blind = TRUE)
  p <- plotPCA(vsd, intgroup = if (hasCov) c("condition", "cov") else "condition",
               returnData = TRUE)
  pv <- round(100 * attr(p, "percentVar"))
  pcaPlot <- ggplot(p, aes(PC1, PC2, colour = condition)) +
    { if (hasCov) geom_point(aes(shape = cov), size = 3) else geom_point(size = 3) } +
    labs(x = paste0("PC1 (", pv[1], "%)"), y = paste0("PC2 (", pv[2], "%)"),
         shape = d$covariate, title = paste(name, "- isoform-level PCA")) +
    theme_minimal()
  print(pcaPlot)
  ggsave(file.path(outDir, paste0(name, "_isoform_PCA.png")), pcaPlot, width = 6, height = 5, bg = "white")

  ## DEXSeq 
  covTerm  <- if (hasCov) " + cov:exon" else ""
  fullF    <- as.formula(paste0("~ sample + exon + condition:exon", covTerm))
  reducedF <- as.formula(paste0("~ sample + exon", covTerm))
  sampleData <- data.frame(condition = meta$condition, row.names = meta$sample_id)
  if (hasCov) sampleData$cov <- meta$cov

  dxd <- DEXSeqDataSet(countData = isoCounts, sampleData = sampleData, design = fullF,
                       featureID = txInfo$isoform_id, groupID = txInfo$gene_id)
  dxd <- estimateSizeFactors(dxd)
  dxd <- estimateDispersions(dxd)
  dxd <- testForDEU(dxd, fullModel = fullF, reducedModel = reducedF)
  dxd <- estimateExonFoldChanges(dxd, fitExpToVar = "condition")
  dexseqResult <- DEXSeqResults(dxd)
  saveRDS(dexseqResult, file.path(outDir, paste0(name, "_dexseqResult.rds")))

  sigIso <- dexseqResult[!is.na(dexseqResult$padj) & dexseqResult$padj < alpha, ]
  cat("Significant isoforms:", nrow(sigIso), " genes:", length(unique(sigIso$groupID)), "\n")

  ## Isoform fraction (IF) and dIF 
  geneTot <- rowsum(isoCounts, txInfo$gene_id)[txInfo$gene_id, ]
  IF <- isoCounts / geneTot
  if (d$paired) {   # mean over donors of the within-donor difference
    dIF <- rowMeans(sapply(levels(meta$cov), function(dn)
      rowMeans(IF[, meta$cov == dn & meta$condition == case, drop = FALSE]) -
      rowMeans(IF[, meta$cov == dn & meta$condition == ref,  drop = FALSE])), na.rm = TRUE)
  } else {
    dIF <- rowMeans(IF[, meta$condition == case], na.rm = TRUE) -
           rowMeans(IF[, meta$condition == ref],  na.rm = TRUE)
  }

  isoRes <- as.data.frame(dexseqResult) %>% as_tibble() %>%
    dplyr::select(gene_id = groupID, isoform_id = featureID, stat, pvalue, padj) %>%
    mutate(dIF = dIF[isoform_id],
           switching = !is.na(padj) & padj < alpha & abs(dIF) > dIFcutoff) %>%
    left_join(isoInfo %>% distinct(gene_id, .keep_all = TRUE) %>% dplyr::select(gene_id, gene_name),
              by = "gene_id")

  ## Isoform switches
  # gene with a switching isoform AND another isoform moving the opposite way
  switches <- isoRes %>% group_by(gene_id) %>%
    filter(any(switching), any(dIF > dIFcutoff), any(dIF < -dIFcutoff)) %>%
    ungroup() %>% filter(abs(dIF) > dIFcutoff) %>% arrange(gene_id, desc(dIF))
  cat("Switching isoforms:", sum(isoRes$switching),
      " genes with an isoform switch:", length(unique(switches$gene_id)), "\n")
  write_csv(switches, file.path(outDir, paste0(name, "_isoform_switches.csv")))

  volcano <- ggplot(isoRes %>% filter(!is.na(padj)), aes(dIF, -log10(padj), colour = switching)) +
    geom_point(size = 0.7) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = c(-dIFcutoff, dIFcutoff), linetype = 2) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(alpha), linetype = 2) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = c("grey70", "firebrick")) +
    labs(x = paste0("dIF (", case, " - ", ref, ")"), y = "-log10(FDR)", colour = "Switch",
         title = paste(name, "- differential isoform usage")) +
    theme_minimal()
  print(volcano)
  ggsave(file.path(outDir, paste0(name, "_volcano.png")), volcano, width = 6, height = 5, bg = "white")

  # IF per sample for the 4 most significant switch genes
  topGenes <- switches %>% arrange(padj) %>% distinct(gene_id) %>% head(4) %>% pull(gene_id)
  if (length(topGenes)) {
    plotDf <- as.data.frame(IF[txInfo$gene_id %in% topGenes, , drop = FALSE]) %>%
      rownames_to_column("isoform_id") %>%
      pivot_longer(-isoform_id, names_to = "sample_id", values_to = "IF") %>%
      left_join(isoRes %>% dplyr::select(isoform_id, gene_name), by = "isoform_id") %>%
      left_join(meta %>% dplyr::select(sample_id, condition), by = "sample_id")
    topPlot <- ggplot(plotDf, aes(isoform_id, IF, fill = condition)) +
      geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA) +
      geom_point(position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.1), size = 0.7) +
      facet_wrap(~ gene_name, scales = "free_x") +
      labs(x = NULL, y = "Isoform fraction (IF)", title = paste(name, "- top isoform switches")) +
      theme_minimal() + theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 7))
    print(topPlot)
    ggsave(file.path(outDir, paste0(name, "_top_switches.png")), topPlot, width = 9, height = 6, bg = "white")
  }

  ## ---- Gene-level summary (exercise code) ----------------------------------
  dexseqResultGene <- isoRes %>% filter(!is.na(stat)) %>%
    group_by(gene_id) %>% slice_min(order_by = pvalue, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
    ungroup() %>% mutate(padj = p.adjust(pvalue, method = "fdr"))

  ## Gene-level DESeq2 with the same design, then compare (exercise code)
  geneCounts <- geneCounts[rowSums(geneCounts >= 10) >= 3, ]
  dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(geneCounts, meta,
                                design = if (hasCov) ~ cov + condition else ~ condition)
  deseq2Res <- as.data.frame(results(DESeq(dds, quiet = TRUE),
                                     contrast = c("condition", case, ref))) %>%
    rownames_to_column("gene_id")

  both <- inner_join(
    dexseqResultGene %>% transmute(gene_id, pvalue_dexseq = pvalue, dex_sig = padj < alpha),
    deseq2Res %>% transmute(gene_id, pvalue_deseq2 = pvalue, deseq_sig = !is.na(padj) & padj < alpha),
    by = "gene_id")
  contigTab <- table(DEXSeq = both$dex_sig, DESeq2 = both$deseq_sig)
  print(contigTab)
  print(fisher.test(contigTab, alternative = "greater"))
  cat("Isoform-usage-only genes (missed by DESeq2):", sum(both$dex_sig & !both$deseq_sig), "\n")

  # For Person 5 (same format as jointDiffRes in week 7)
  write_csv(both %>% dplyr::select(gene_id, pvalue_deseq2, pvalue_dexseq),
            file.path(outDir, paste0(name, "_jointDiffRes.csv")))

  list(gene = dexseqResultGene, iso = isoRes, switches = switches)
}
```

### Run both datasets (this can be very slow)

```{r run}
resInVitro <- runIsoformAnalysis(inVitro)
resInVivo  <- runIsoformAnalysis(inVivo)
```

### In vitro vs smokers

```{r}
# 1) Same genes? ORA on the genes tested in both datasets
cmp <- inner_join(resInVitro$gene %>% transmute(gene_id, sigInVitro = padj < alpha),
                  resInVivo$gene  %>% transmute(gene_id, sigInVivo  = padj < alpha),
                  by = "gene_id")
crossTab <- table(InVitro = cmp$sigInVitro, InVivo = cmp$sigInVivo)
print(crossTab)
print(fisher.test(crossTab, alternative = "greater"))

# 2) Same direction? For isoforms switching in vitro, does usage move the same way in smokers?
isoCmp <- inner_join(
  resInVitro$iso %>% dplyr::select(isoform_id, gene_name, dIF_vitro = dIF, switch_vitro = switching),
  resInVivo$iso  %>% dplyr::select(isoform_id, dIF_vivo = dIF, switch_vivo = switching),
  by = "isoform_id")
swVitro <- isoCmp %>% filter(switch_vitro, !is.na(dIF_vivo))
nSame <- sum(sign(swVitro$dIF_vitro) == sign(swVitro$dIF_vivo))
cat("In vitro switching isoforms changing in the same direction in smokers:",
    nSame, "of", nrow(swVitro), "\n")
if (nrow(swVitro)) print(binom.test(nSame, nrow(swVitro), p = 0.5, alternative = "greater"))

# 3) Switches found in both datasets, same direction
sharedSwitches <- isoCmp %>% filter(switch_vitro, switch_vivo, sign(dIF_vitro) == sign(dIF_vivo))
print(sharedSwitches)
write_csv(sharedSwitches, file.path(outDir, "shared_switches_invitro_invivo.csv"))

dIFplot <- ggplot(isoCmp, aes(dIF_vitro, dIF_vivo, colour = switch_vitro & switch_vivo)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = "grey60") + geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = "grey60") +
  geom_point(size = 0.7) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("grey70", "purple")) +
  labs(x = "dIF in vitro (CS - air)", y = "dIF in vivo (smoker - non-smoker)",
       colour = "Switch in both", title = "Isoform usage changes: in vitro vs smokers") +
  theme_minimal()
print(dIFplot)
ggsave(file.path(outDir, "dIF_invitro_vs_invivo.png"), dIFplot, width = 6, height = 5, bg = "white")
```
